# DSH Auto Work Details
A small browser-side DSH plugin that expands a running work-detail group at the standard height and
folds that group when its segment finishes.
## Compatibility
Verified: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (source review and automated checks); Desktop testing has not been complete
rified: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (source review and automated checks); Desktop testing has not been completed.
## Behaviour

- Always on while the bundle is enabled; the plugin has no Settings entry.
- Each composer observes
only its own Conversation, including an embedded child chat. Switching its session or unmounting it

disposes that observer.
- While a process group is running (`[data-shimmer]` is present on its heade
r), a collapsed group is opened once through the native header click. That path uses Chat's own `ini
tialize('bottom')` and follow logic, so the standard height cap and bottom-following are preserved.

- When the group stops running, the group is closed once through the same native control.
- Manual t
oggles during the same running segment are not fought: the observer reacts only to the transition in

to and out of the running phase.
- The synthetic click suppresses the header's `focus()` call, so op
ening a group does not steal the caret from the composer.
Earlier versions exposed a switch that stored `dsh-auto-work-details.enabled` in `localStorage`; the
plugin now removes that leftover key when it loads.
## Limits
This is a DOM-level workaround, not a Chat extension point:
- It depends on Conversation's `[data-conversation-content]` / `[data-conversation-session]` scope a
nd Chat's `[data-step-process]`, `[data-chat-group-key]`, `[data-shimmer]`, and `aria-expanded` mark

ers. An unresolved or mismatched Conversation is left alone.
- It only works in modes that render a
process-group header (Standard and Compact); Detailed and Verbose have no running group header to to

ggle.
- An auto-close is skipped when Chat's focus protection decides the group must stay visible, o

r when a whole-Turn fold is already animating that group.
- A future Chat update can change these ma
rkers without notice.
## Install
Clone this fork (`iBobbyTS/dsh-auto-work-details`) and install its checkout as a DSH bundle. Replace
the path and choose the profile you actually use:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For Desktop, use its bundled CLI with `--profile desktop`, after launching Desktop once and quitting
it. Restart the target Host and refresh its client after installing.
`dsh plugin ... add` links the package and also records `@local/dsh-auto-work-details` in the profil
e's `dsh.profile.bundles`; installing through the Plugin Manager performs the same steps.
